    Extremely disappointed with the Pixel 8a. Here's why:🔥 Overheats like crazy – 20 minutes of Call of Duty and it feels like holding a hot brick. Totally unusable for gaming.🔋 Battery is a joke – Drains fast even on standby. Can’t last a full day without touching it.🔒 Fingerprint sensor is garbage – Fails to recognize prints most of the time. Basic unlocking becomes frustrating.💸 Totally overpriced – Phones under ₹22,000 perform miles better.🛑 Overall experience? Pathetic – Feels like a rushed, poorly optimized device.Verdict: Google seriously dropped the ball. Do NOT waste your money on this phone.
